blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has ordered government agencies to strengthen security at transport terminals and prepare emergency assistance for stranded passengers during Undas, as millions of Filipinos are expected to travel to their home provinces to visit departed loved ones. In a statement on Monday, Executive Secretary Ralph Recto said the directive includes deploying more police officers and K-9 units at major transport hubs, ensuring sufficient public transportation, and studying the possibility of random drug testing for public utility vehicle (PUV) drivers.
